items.quote: Several respondents noted that Jorin Wilington took ownership of steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Jorin led reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth across the department.
Direct reports said that Jorin Wilington drove media interviews and press conferences for the whole division.
Jorin handled root cause analysis of recurring service failures competently within his team.
Jorin Wilington set the direction for efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Jorin headed efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion, setting priorities for several teams.
Several respondents noted that Jorin Wilington was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of upholding governance and audit standards.
Direct reports said that Jorin Wilington led piloting new approaches to grant applications across the department.
Peers observed that Jorin championed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He spearheaded drafting legislative amendments for the new act at the national level.
